text:
mikaela: FYI inbound spike from the webinar landing page (utm_campaign=redwood_webinar_apr). HS webhooks slowed and enrichment lambdas started timing out. ~40 leads came in between 14:02-14:06 and ~12 of them show as "intake:unclaimed". Need low-friction fix so SDRs don't lose SLAs.

devon: Do we know if HS sent duplicates or if webhook retries created backpressure? Grafana shows a sudden webhook latency jump at 14:03.

alerts-bot: HubSpot webhook latency: 78s avg for 14:02-14:06. Webhook retry count increased x3. Enrichment lambda 504 spike at 14:04:12.

raj: Potential root cause: enrichment service hit DB connection limit under burst. Short-term plan: bypass enrichment for intake (accept minimal payload) and route to fallback queue. Long-term: scale DB pool / add circuit breaker.

olivia: I can toggle routing but need exact criteria. We should only bypass enrichment for leads tagged utm_campaign=redwood_webinar_apr to avoid broad changes.

andre: Agree. Quick rule: if hs_utms contains "redwood_webinar_apr" AND enrichment_status==pending for >5s, assign owner = "SDR Webinar Queue" and set intake_flag:allow_partial=true. Add internal note: "partial intake - full enrichment pending".

kyle: SF implications: creating lead with partial data won't violate external_id dedupe, but will create task notifications. We can suppress create_task webhook for these records by setting intake_flag:suppress_task=true. That avoids noisy tasks and lets SDRs get a batched digest.

mikaela: Good. Dev plan: 1) devon -> patch intake config to add targeted fallback rule and allow_partial + suppress_task for utm_campaign match. 2) raj -> hotfix enrichment DB pool (raise max connections by 20), 3) olivia -> monitor SF tasks & dup rate, 4) andre -> update HubSpot workflow note and create a saved filter for hs_fallback=true. 5) kyle -> prepare a short SDR message template and set digest cadence 10m.

devon: I'll apply a canary to staging with this rule first. Curl to patch config (staging):
```bash
curl -X PATCH "https://internal-config.redwood/api/v1/lead-routing" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"round_robin": {"targeted_fallbacks": [{"match": {"hs_utms": "redwood_webinar_apr", "enrichment_status": "pending", "pending_seconds_gt": 5}, "owner": "SDR Webinar Queue", "intake_flags": {"allow_partial": true, "suppress_task": true, "hs_fallback": "true"}}]}}'
```

raj: Increasing DB pool now on enrichment-primary: helm patch applied, new replicas picked up.

alerts-bot: Deployment: enrichment-db-config updated by raj at 14:08:33.

devon: Canary applied to staging. Running 50-event smoke (simulate utm_campaign).

mikaela: Olivia, once staging smoke is green, can you approve prod roll? Set rollback if SF dup_rate > 1.5/min or total_suppressed_tasks > 20 in 15m.

olivia: On it. I'll also enable channel heartbeat to #inbound-handoff. If we see >2 unexpected owner-changes/min we rollback.

andre: I'll add the HubSpot property hs_fallback=true and a workflow note. Also adding a one-liner to the SDR digest template: "Leads from webinar may have partial enrichment; full profile will follow."

kyle: Drafting SDR digest now. Will include sample outreach copy and link to saved filter.

devon: Rolling to prod in 60s. ETA: immediate.

alerts-bot: Config patch: lead-routing updated by devon at 14:10:11. Canary traffic flipped to production for utm match.

mikaela: Thanks. Team watch list: 30m window. Postmortem: open ticket later (JIRA-4001). If everything stabilizes, we'll keep allow_partial window open for 1 hour and then revert.

olivia: Smoke passed. No dup spikes. Suppressed tasks = 8 in first 10m. All good so far.

mikaela: Awesome. After 30m, leave a note whether to keep changes for the rest of the day or fully revert. :tada:
